class.name: HTMLDocument
class.brief_description: HTML/CSS source data for an HTML render surface.
class.description: Stores pure HTML and CSS-oriented document inputs for [HTMLView], [HTMLRenderTarget], and [HTMLSurface3D]. Unsupported executable constructs are reported by [method get_source_errors].

members.member: Default document background color used when the HTML/CSS source does not provide one. The default is transparent black.
Default render size used when a surface has no explicit size.
Inline CSS source applied after [member css_files].
Ordered list of CSS files applied to the document. Entries may be [code]res://[/code], [code]user://[/code], or relative to [member html_file]'s directory or [member resource_root].
Path to an HTML file. File loading is reserved for the renderer backend.
Base resource root used by the renderer backend for local assets.
Compatibility shortcut for setting [member background_color]'s alpha to transparent or opaque.

method.name: add_css_file
method.description: Appends a CSS file path to [member css_files].

method.name: get_source_errors
method.description: Returns unsupported source constructs found during the document preflight check.

method.name: is_source_valid
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the document source preflight check found no unsupported constructs.

method.name: reload
method.description: Requests that dependent surfaces reload the document.

method.name: remove_css_file
method.description: Removes all matching CSS file paths from [member css_files].
